critique: The color and expanding burst read as hot fire, and the frame at 0.08s is larger and more spark-filled than 0.01s. However, both frames remain a soft, rounded orange particle cloud. It lacks the crisp pointed flame tongues, bright hot core, and directional cone/starburst silhouette expected from an Explosive muzzle flash. The burst also continues to build through 0.08s rather than peaking immediately and rapidly dissipating.

suggestions.why: Reduce the 100% particle feather so the flash edge breaks into sharper flame spikes instead of a blurred orange blob.
Narrow the 45-degree directional spread to form a more identifiable directional muzzle-blast cone.
Reduce the very strong position turbulence that is inflating the burst into soft rounded lobes; a lower value preserves a cleaner explosive silhouette.
Make the emission a true instant flash rather than continuing to add particles through 0.08 seconds.
Shorten particle life so the flash peaks immediately and clears rapidly rather than remaining a dense fireball at the later frame.
